title: Sudut Kiri Papan Putih
genre: 1960s Malay filmi song (Hindustani-influenced Malay film song with sitar and tabla)
subject: Two tuition-centre teachers share one whiteboard and never meet, so he starts answering her leftover chalk-corner notes in the top left corner she never wipes
caption: 1960s Malay filmi song, slow-swaying sub-style from Malay film-studio ballads. Sitar playing sliding melodic phrases, tabla and dholak in an eight-beat pattern, harmonium holding long chords, pizzicato violins answering each line, soft upright bass. Warm mono studio sound, plate reverb on the voice, light tape hiss. Male tenor lead, mid register, gentle vibrato, plain tender delivery. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 92 BPM, A minor. Tender, shy, slow-swaying mood. No electric guitar, no drum kit, no synth, no autotune, no rap, no trap hi-hats.
lyrics:
[Intro - sitar, harmonium, tabla]

[Verse 1]
Aku ajar Matematik, sampai pukul lima
Kau ajar Bahasa, enam setengah
Satu papan putih, satu pen merah
Kita bertukar bilik, tak pernah bertemu

[Pre-Chorus]
Kau lap papan sampai bersih
Tapi sudut kiri, kau biarkan

[Chorus]
Sudut kiri papan putih
Tempat kita berbual tanpa suara
Aku tulis x tambah y
Kau lukis bintang kecil di bawahnya

[Verse 2]
Hari Selasa aku tulis soalan
Berapa jauh hati ke hatimu
Esok pagi ada jawapan kecil
Ukurlah sendiri, bawa pembaris

[Pre-Chorus]
Murid-murid tanya, cikgu senyum apa
Aku padam semua, kecuali satu

[Chorus]
Sudut kiri papan putih
Hari ini aku tulis namaku
Tunggu kau datang, enam setengah
Kau jawab dengan namamu pula

[Bridge - sitar alone, then tabla]
Pen merah tinggal separuh
Esok kita pinjam satu lagi

[Outro - sitar and harmonium]
Sudut kiri, sudut kiri
Jangan dipadam, jangan dipadam
